name: CategoriX: AI Product Categorization for WooCommerce
author: categorix

sections.description:
CategoriX analyses your product titles and descriptions and assigns the best-fit category in your WooCommerce category tree — without fragile keyword rules or hours of manual sorting.

It’s designed for stores with messy or fast-growing catalogues: dropshipping, multi-supplier imports, agencies, and anyone tired of “Uncategorized”.

Get started with CategoriX

How It Works

  1. Connect — Paste your API key from CategoriX. Your WooCommerce categories sync automatically.
  2. Bulk categorise — Start a bulk categorisation run from the dashboard. Products are processed in the background using WooCommerce’s Action Scheduler, so your site stays responsive.
  3. Review — High-confidence matches can be applied automatically. Anything uncertain goes into the Review Queue for your approval.
  4. Keep it tidy — Optionally auto-categorise new products as they’re created, so your catalogue stays organised over time.

CategoriX is powered by the same core engine built for ~99% accuracy, while confidence scoring ensures you stay in control when matches are uncertain.

Key Features

  • AI categorisation (to your WooCommerce categories) — Uses product title and description to pick the best category in your store.
  • Confidence scoring — Every suggestion gets a 0–100 confidence score, with thresholds you control.
  • Background bulk processing — Categorise large catalogues safely in the background (no timeouts, no “freeze the admin” moments).
  • Review Queue — Clear current vs suggested category comparison. Approve, reject, or revert with one click.
  • Safety Lock — Skips products that have been manually categorised by a human (and by default focuses on “Uncategorized”).
  • Category tree sync — Your WooCommerce categories are synced so products map to your real store structure.
  • Revert anytime — Undo individual changes or roll back a whole batch.
  • Auto-categorise new products — Optionally categorise new products as they’re added.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 5.0 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • A CategoriX account and API key — Get started

Pricing

CategoriX offers simple monthly plans for WooCommerce stores of all sizes. Every plan includes bulk categorisation, automatic category sync, and confidence scoring.

View current plans and pricing
sections.installation:
1. Download CategoriX from WordPress.org or search for “CategoriX” under Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Create a CategoriX account if you don’t have one already.
  4. Go to CategoriX > Settings and paste your API key.
  5. Click Save & Connect — your categories will sync automatically.
  6. Head to CategoriX > Dashboard and start categorising.
sections.faq:
Do I need a CategoriX account?

Yes. The AI categorisation is powered by the CategoriX cloud service. Create a free account to get your API key and start categorising.

Will it overwrite my existing categories?

No. By default, CategoriX only processes products sitting in “Uncategorized”. The Safety Lock feature protects anything you’ve manually categorised. You can also choose to re-categorise all products if needed.

How accurate is the AI?

CategoriX is built for ~99% accuracy. The AI understands product context — not just keywords — by analysing titles, descriptions, brands, and attributes. Any result that isn’t high-confidence is sent to the Review Queue for your approval, so you always have the final say.

Does it work with large catalogues?

Absolutely. CategoriX processes up to 500 products per minute in the background using WooCommerce’s Action Scheduler. Your site stays fully responsive, and it can comfortably handle catalogues with millions of products.

Can I undo the changes?

Yes. Every change is tracked. You can revert individual products or roll back an entire batch from the Review Queue.

What data is sent to the API?

Product name, description, brand (if available), current category, and product attributes are sent to the CategoriX API for classification. No customer data, order data, or payment information is ever transmitted.
